sources.title: DeepSeek V4-Flash-Vision-Exp: Multimodal Agent Benchmarks - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: DeepSeek shipped DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1 on the same day with out-of-the-box support, and the model is live now via model='deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp'. This follows a pattern explainx.ai has tracked all August: DeepSeek shipping V4 Pro 0813, a 50-1,100% API price increase, and verified ARC-AGI numbers for V4 Flash 0731 in rapid succession.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp: Vision API, Benchmarks & Cost - iweaver.ai
sources.snippet: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal model available through its API. It accepts both text and images, bringing screenshot understanding, chart analysis, OCR-style tasks and other visual workflows into the V4 Flash family.
